title: Director identity details (KYC)
summary: Each proposed director's identity details are entered in SPICe+ Part B and verified. Directors without a DIN get one on incorporation.

sources.title: Instruction Kit for Form No. SPICe + Part B

steps.title: Prepare director identity details
steps.description: Each director gives a DIN, or for a new director: Income-tax PAN (or Voter ID, Passport or Driving Licence number). Name, father's name and date of birth are verified against the PAN database; details can be fetched from DigiLocker.

documents.name: Income-tax PAN (or Voter ID, Passport or Driving Licence number)
documents.note: A new director's PAN must not already be linked to a DIN.

fee.note: No separate fee stated in the reviewed sources.

review.note: Checked 2026-09-28, SPICe+ Part B kit: "users name, father's name and date of birth shall be verified from the PAN database".
